title: Codex CLI 0.125.0
description: New features include Unix socket transport for app-server integrations, pagination-friendly resume/fork, sticky environments, and remote thread config/store plumbing. Permission profiles now round-trip across TUI sessions.

community_feedback.quote: This is a meaningful app-server and policy-plumbing release featuring Unix socket app-server transport

title: GPT-5.5 Integration
description: Codex announced GPT-5.5 as OpenAI's newest frontier model for complex coding, computer use, knowledge work, and research workflows.

community_feedback.quote: The model oneshotted it in 20 mins. That's insane.
Important thing is a language model is an unconscious machine with no self-context so once given a command an input, it WILL produce an output.

title: GPT-5.5 Integration
description: Windsurf announced GPT-5.5 is now available in the editor, adding the latest OpenAI model to their suite of AI models.

title: OAuth Authentication Fixes
description: Fixed OAuth authentication issues for some MCP servers in version 2.0.67.

title: Devin Cloud Connection Improvements
description: Improved reliability of Devin Cloud connections in Windsurf and fixed OAuth integration regression for some MCP servers.

title: April 2026 Update
description: Claude Code released major updates including the /powerup onboarding system, expanded MCP with 500K tool limits, improved subagent capabilities, and Agent SDK rewrite.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 Integration
description: Claude Opus 4.7 is now available in Windsurf, bringing Anthropic's latest model to the editor.

title: Canvases Feature
description: Cursor introduced interactive canvases that can include visualizations, dashboards, and custom interfaces built using first-party components.

title: Async Multitasking in Agents Window
description: New async multitasking capabilities allow AI agents to work on multiple tasks simultaneously with /multitask command.

title: Multi-root Workspaces
description: Agents Window now supports multi-root workspaces for making cross-repo changes spanning frontend, backend, and shared libraries.
